item.title: My Egregore Burst
item.description: In 2024 I started forming an egregore, on twitter. I did this by learning things in my own language. I’d ask my open questions, most people in the network didn’t know the answer, but those who did would contribute and say “this is already well known in <domain X>” I’d take that and integrate it, compress it.

item.title: No one cares that mamdani "lied" on his college application
item.description: No one cares that mamdani “lied” on his college application (1/n) To those who hate him: this is a dumb criticism. There are good reasons why they think he’s a bad candidate, and if this is what they’re holding up, then it makes them look like they’re scraping the barrel and have no real arguments.

item.title: How to test the metacognition of your audience
Awareness can exist without minds
item.description: What is an electron aware of? An electron is “aware of” other electrons (they repel), and protons (they attract). An electron is NOT aware of, say, an oxygen molecule.

item.title: It Is Not Safe to Perceive Everything
item.description: This is true. If you reject this truth, your mind will take over the steering wheel. There will be things hidden outside of where your thoughts can go, because you are not ready for them.
